summary: Empresa Distribuidora y Comercializadora Norte S.A. (EDENOR) filed a Form 6-K reporting a board resolution to call an Ordinary General Shareholders Meeting for July 27, 2026. The meeting will be held remotely. The filing is a routine notice of a shareholders meeting with no disclosed special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or activist campaign. No financial terms, advisor names, or structural details are provided. This is a standard procedural filing, not a special situation.
